description:
The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC. ![Yaak 2026.8.1](https://yaak.app/changelog-og/2026.8.1/banner.png?v=3) The [changelog for 2026.8.1](https://yaak.app/changelog/2026.8.1) has the full write-up, with screenshots of the headline features. Here's everything that changed. ### 🛠️ Fixed • Fix PDF previews failing to load ([#704](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/704), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/view-pdf-bug)) • Fix autocomplete producing malformed tags after manually typing a template opener ([#692](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/692), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/grpc-body-params-strange-behavior))
> *These binaries follow Yaak's [pricing terms](https://yaak.app/pricing)：free for personal use, license required for commercial use. The source is MIT licensed and can be built and run for free, for both personal and commercial use.*
